title: intake on the repository backlog runs for minutes: the drift detector runs every eligible item's checks, full tests.py included
goal: python3 _tools/backlog.py intake finishes within 60 seconds on the repository backlog, so the SessionStart hook can run it: the drift detector bounds the checks it runs (a total budget, and never a check that runs the full tests.py or stress_test.py) and counts what it skipped; a test plants an item whose check sleeps past the budget

run: import subprocess,sys; p=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','intake'],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL); r=[None]; exec('try: p.wait(60); r[0]=0\nexcept subprocess.TimeoutExpired: p.kill(); print(\'intake ran over 60 s\'); r[0]=1'); sys.exit(r[0])

notes: A plain intake on the repository ran over 10 minutes on 2026-10-01 with tests.py as its child process: the drift detector runs the checks of every draft or todo item whose touches changed since its file did, and some items check with the full tests.py.
